Subject: Physics
Chapters: Ray optics and optical instruments; Wave optics
How to write the answer: Ray diagrams with arrows; derivations with a labelled figure and the result boxed.
How to prepare fast: The biggest unit: lens and mirror formulae, prism, microscope and telescope, interference and diffraction.

Subject: Physics
Chapters: Moving charges and magnetism; Magnetism and matter; Electromagnetic induction; Alternating currents
How to write the answer: State the law, draw the figure, then derive; give units in every numerical.
How to prepare fast: Biot–Savart and Ampère's law, force between wires, LCR circuits and the transformer.

Subject: Physics
Chapters: Electric charges and fields; Potential and capacitance; Current electricity
How to write the answer: For Gauss's law draw the Gaussian surface; for Kirchhoff's laws mark currents first.
How to prepare fast: Capacitor combinations, the Wheatstone and metre bridges, and the potentiometer.

Subject: Physics
Unit: Dual Nature of Radiation and Matter
Chapters: Photoelectric effect; matter waves
How to write the answer: Draw the photoelectric graphs with labelled axes.
How to prepare fast: Einstein's equation and de Broglie wavelength numericals.

Subject: Physics
Chapters: Semiconductor electronics
How to write the answer: Circuit diagrams and I–V graphs for diodes and rectifiers.
How to prepare fast: Rectifiers, the Zener diode and logic of the p-n junction.

Subject: Physics
Chapters: Atoms; Nuclei
How to write the answer: Formula-based short answers; balance nuclear equations.
How to prepare fast: Bohr model, binding energy and radioactive decay.

Subject: Physics
Chapters: Electromagnetic waves
How to write the answer: Give the order of the spectrum with one use of each band.
How to prepare fast: Learn the spectrum table.

Subject: Chemistry
Chapters: Haloalkanes and haloarenes; Alcohols, phenols and ethers; Aldehydes, ketones and carboxylic acids; Organic compounds containing nitrogen; Biomolecules
How to write the answer: Write reactions with reagents and conditions; give mechanisms where asked; name reactions with the equation.
How to prepare fast: Nearly half the paper: make a reactions sheet and practise conversion questions daily.

Subject: Chemistry
Chapters: Solutions; Electrochemistry; Chemical kinetics
How to write the answer: Show every step of numericals with units; write the formula first.
How to prepare fast: Colligative properties, the Nernst equation and rate-law numericals.

Subject: Chemistry
Chapters: d- and f-block elements; Coordination compounds
How to write the answer: Give reasons in one line; IUPAC names, hybridisation and magnetic nature in a table.
How to prepare fast: Coordination compounds naming and crystal-field theory, and trends in transition elements.

Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: Continuity & Differentiability; Application of Derivatives; Integrals; Application of Integrals; Differential Equations
How to write the answer: Show every step, because step marks matter. Draw the region in area questions and write + C.
How to prepare fast: Nearly half the paper: do every NCERT integration exercise, then maxima and minima word problems.

Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: Relations and Functions; Inverse Trigonometric Functions
How to write the answer: For an equivalence relation, prove reflexive, symmetric and transitive one by one.
How to prepare fast: Learn the table of principal-value branches.

Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: Matrices; Determinants
How to write the answer: Check an inverse by multiplying back to the identity, and show the cofactors in a grid.
How to prepare fast: Solving equations by the matrix method is almost always asked.

Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: Probability
How to write the answer: Describe the events in words first. For Bayes' theorem, draw a tree.
How to prepare fast: Bayes' theorem and probability distributions come up often.

Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: Three-dimensional geometry
How to write the answer: State the formula first; for shortest distance write the vector form.
How to prepare fast: Equations of lines and planes, angle between lines, shortest distance.

Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: Vectors
How to write the answer: Write vectors with arrows or hats; show dot and cross products step by step.
How to prepare fast: Dot and cross product applications; quick marks.

Subject: Mathematics
Chapters: Linear Programming
How to write the answer: Draw the graph neatly, shade the feasible region and make a table of corner points.
How to prepare fast: Full marks with one well-practised method.

Subject: Biology
Chapters: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants; Human Reproduction; Reproductive Health
How to write the answer: Labelled diagrams — embryo sac, sections of testis and ovary, the menstrual cycle.
How to prepare fast: Practise the diagrams daily and learn each process as a flowchart.

Subject: Biology
Chapters: Principles of Inheritance & Variation; Molecular Basis of Inheritance; Evolution
How to write the answer: Draw crosses with Punnett squares. Explain the lac operon and DNA replication with diagrams.
How to prepare fast: Second only to Reproduction: start with Molecular Basis of Inheritance and practise crosses.

Subject: Biology
Chapters: Organisms & Populations; Ecosystem; Biodiversity & Conservation
How to write the answer: Use graphs, such as population growth curves, and examples.
How to prepare fast: Short chapters and quick marks.

Subject: Biology
Chapters: Human Health & Disease; Microbes in Human Welfare
How to write the answer: Give disease, pathogen, symptoms and prevention as a table.
How to prepare fast: Revising in tables is fastest.

Subject: Biology
Chapters: Biotechnology: Principles & Processes; Biotechnology & its Applications
How to write the answer: Explain steps in order, such as recombinant DNA and PCR, as a flowchart.
How to prepare fast: Learn the steps of recombinant DNA technology and PCR, and Bt crops.

Subject: English
Chapters: Composition, directed writing, proposal, grammar; prescribed literature texts
How to write the answer: Plan compositions before writing and keep to the word limit; quote and explain from the text in literature answers.
How to prepare fast: Write one composition a week and get it checked; revise the literature texts by theme and character.
